scope: Diagnostics observed in retained QEMU guest logs that did not stop those runs. Entries are reviewed evidence, not acceptance. A new failure-shaped line fails the task until it is classified here with a reason.

*.pattern: EFI variables are not supported on this system.
*.reason: Printed by the SteamOS bootloader helper in retained successful deployments; the tool-created QEMU disk has no UEFI variable store. Bootloader files were still installed.

*.pattern: acpi PNP0A03:00: fail to add MMCONFIG information
*.reason: Kernel ACPI notice at QEMU boot in retained runs; extended PCI configuration space is not needed by the guest tasks.

deployment-test.pattern: realpath: /dev/disk/by-partsets/self/rootfs: No such file or directory
deployment-test.reason: Printed once per slot during bootloader configuration in retained successful deployments; the helper probes a path that does not exist in the minimal guest. Not isolated; other tasks must classify it themselves.
Printed without a visible failing command in retained successful deployments; cause not isolated. Do not extend this entry without a reviewed reason.

resize-prepared.reason: sfdisk corrects the primary GPT size after the staging image grows to the selected capacity; observed three times in each retained 80 to 128 GiB expansion.
